_comment: Real-data mock corpus for social syndication design work (#324). Every social mock and, later, every render test draws from these records so designs are judged against genuine content — including the ugly cases. Extracted 2026-08-20 from public/data/. Re-derive rather than hand-edit if the archive changes.

medianLinerNote.headline: Thompson Twins in 1984: The Year of 1984 Los Angeles Summer Olympics
medianLinerNote.why: Median prose length across the 57 published posts. The baseline everything is judged against.

fullCircle.headline: "Notorious": Nile Rodgers and Duran Duran, 39 Years Apart
fullCircle.why: Densest data payload any detector produces — two artists, two venues, two years, plus a song title and a gap. Used across all four artboards in the imagery-direction canvas (#325).

longestArtistName.name: Richard Cheese & Lounge Against The Machine
runnersUp: Jah Wobble's Invaders of the Heart

longestVenueName.name: National Museum of African American History and Culture
longestVenueName.why: Type overflow in footer/metadata position. Longer than any artist name, and the footer has less room.

fourShowDate.why: Tests the On This Day multi-record layout. Only three dates in the archive carry four shows; every other day has three or fewer.

fortyYearAnniversary.why: Best-case On This Day post — the high end of anniversary weighting.

noImageRecord.why: A post whose image ref resolves to nothing, exercising the PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE_URL branch that #252 made reachable. Not yet identified — needs a pipeline run with image resolution to surface one, since the ref is re-resolved every run rather than stored.

supply.why: Drives On This Day cadence (#333) and Track B's generative artwork. perYearCounts is what the canvas actually renders.
